text.content:
A virtual emotional amputee, unable to make the connections needed to feel joy, sadness, anger or love, even under supernatural compulsion such as Dominate or the blood bond — the character goes through the motions without real investment. Frenzy manifests as chillingly silent violence; Rötschreck as a silent, instinctive flight.

Trigger/Effect: The character suffers a one-Trait penalty to Social challenges requiring genuine warmth or emotion, cannot purchase Performance, and faces +2 difficulty on any Humanity/Path Virtue (Conscience/Conviction) test.

Source: Clanbook: Malkavian, New Derangements.
